tldr: For fixed potential outcomes in \([0,1]^{2n}\), the sharp joint-design, all-estimator risk for the causal marginal variance contrast is \(R_n=1/(4n)-\kappa n^{-4/3}+o(n^{-4/3})\), where \(\kappa=-\alpha/2=0.509396\ldots\) and \(\alpha\) is the greatest real zero of \(\operatorname{Ai}'\). The displayed total clipped cutoff Airy rule attains this expansion uniformly on the complete continuous cube under fair independent assignment and floor-balanced complete randomization, for both parities. A finite-target information certificate supplies a matching converse for every ex ante assignment law and every Borel, possibly independently randomized estimator. Binary monotone endpoint-coupling priors are least favorable through the correction order; exact finite-sample minimaxity and subsequent design separation remain open.
gap: Current bounded-mean joint minimax results rely on a target-preserving coordinate symmetry and a mean-specific convex endpoint transfer. A marginal variance difference lacks these reductions.
